scope_note: Thirty residual modeled syntheses remain after the Google Bridgeport evidence audit. They retain published Deloitte/Google IMPLAN channels as source-modeled outputs, the lower-bound payroll annualization, exact annual paid-tax aggregations plus a 2025 equal-cost threshold, and three low-confidence descriptive county comparison gaps. Source-reported environmental values now live in the governed direct-evidence catalog. The models do not allocate campus/state results to the selected building, invent supplier spend/payroll/public costs, convert workers to job-years, estimate incentives or net fiscal impact, or treat source projections as actuals.

estimates.label: Annualized direct-wage projection floor

period.label: Alabama Commerce 20-year Project Spike projection horizon

scope.label: Google Project Spike/Jackson County direct-wage projection

interval.interpretation: Deterministic annualized lower-bound threshold: greater than $93.6 million divided by 20 years; not an exact payroll forecast.

provenance.detail: State-reported direct-wage projection exceeds $93.6 million over 20 years

estimates.confidence_rationale: The arithmetic and source horizon are explicit, but the source value is a lower-bound projection with no realized payroll, annual schedule or selected-building allocation.
estimates.decision_relevance: Converts the state’s explicit cumulative wage projection floor to a comparable annual floor without treating it as actual payroll.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Actual annual facility payroll, employees, occupations, contractor compensation, residence and projection methodology.

derivation.formula: $93.6 million projected direct-wage floor ÷ 20 years = $4.68 million per year floor
assumptions: The source projection is spread evenly only for presentation; actual annual timing is unknown.
Because the source says wages top $93.6 million, $4.68 million is a lower-bound threshold, not an exact central forecast.

limitations: Source projection, not observed payroll.
Smooth annualization hides timing and wage escalation.
Direct-wage definition and employee/contractor coverage are not disclosed.
Unallocated to the selected building.
estimates.notes: The separate $129 million 20-year economic-impact projection is not annualized because the source does not define its measure.

estimates.confidence_rationale: The calculation is reproducible, but attribution, scope completeness or comparison design remains weak.

estimates.label: Modeled county total employment comparison gap

period.label: 2024 Jackson County outcome relative to a mechanically matched benchmark; 2018 opening anchor

interval.interpretation: Envelope is plus or minus the greater of five percentage points or twice 2010-2017 pre-period RMSE; fit sensitivity, not statistical confidence.

parameters.name: comparison_2024_value
parameters.transformation: Subtracted from host and used as denominator

estimates.confidence_rationale: The benchmark is reproducible, but timing, attribution and donor contamination remain unresolved.
estimates.decision_relevance: Shows Jackson County's 2024 divergence without assigning it to Google.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Causal design with isolated timing, complete exposure history, verified controls, placebos, spillover rules and robustness diagnostics.

assumptions: Matching uses 2010-2017 log level, average log growth and growth volatility.
All selected study counties are excluded from donors.
Disputed 2018/2019 chronology is not assumed to isolate treatment.

limitations: Descriptive comparison, not a data-center effect.
Construction, expansion and concurrent county changes are not isolated.
Donor screen cannot exclude every unobserved treatment.
Interval is fit sensitivity, not statistical confidence.
estimates.notes: No causal_design metadata is attached.
